syllabus_topics: Mechanical manufacturing methods: design of the preliminary project for the manufacturing process of a micromechanical product.
Manufacturing dimensioning and statistical process control.
Introduction to tooling design (injection mold and follow-on tools for cutting-bending and stamping).
Metrology and quality: Uncertainty calculations and metrology for micromechanics.
Characterization of non-contact metrology processes and control of operating modes.
Study of specific standards and applications to surface finish measurement and geometric product specification.
Quality deployment in production for a 0 ppm objective – Damien Chardaire – Sonceboz SA (Conference).
Experimental designs: fractional experimental designs and Taguchi method.

assessment_methods.method: Practical work or project (Méthodes de fabrication mécanique)
Practical work or project (Métrologie et qualité)
